mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5%, it signals economic weakness requiring aggressive monetary stimulus, which drives S&P 500 forward returns positively over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST and RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, leading to stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals economic overheating and impending monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of late-cycle expansion periods with rising INDPRO, or the Rank IC for the regime-conditional signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the core CPI exceeds 2.5%, it triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances with CPIAUCSL annual inflation > 2.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions, driving corporate hiring and revenue growth, which generates positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with rising PAYEMS, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment recovery regimes, a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals improving economic conditions and increased consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of high unemployment recovery periods with declining UNRATE, or the Rank IC for the regime-conditional signal is below 0.03.
